summary: Iter 26 — Messagerie group/attachments/emoji polish tested end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iter26_messagerie_groups_attachments.py covering (a) POST /api/channels/group persists members under 'members_ids' (bug fix confirmed — creator + selected members all appear, GET /api/channels shows correct count for both creator and invitees), (b) POST /api/channels/{cid}/members adds & persists / rejects duplicates / 404 on unknown employee / 400 on DM, (c) DELETE /api/channels/{cid}/members/{eid} removes & persists, (d) PATCH /api/channels/{cid} updates name & avatar_url (400 on DM), (e) POST /api/uploads returns /api/uploads/<uuid>.ext URL, (f) POST /api/channels/{cid}/messages accepts attachments list (image + non-image), persists them, allows attachment-only send, rejects fully-empty payload, (g) DM send + read regression still 200. Frontend Playwright (logged as Marcus admin via localStorage bypass): 5/5 flows PASS — group created via '+ new message → Groupe' shows in sidebar with correct member count and 3 members (creator+2 selected) in msg-info-panel msg-members-list; msg-add-member-btn opens modal that filters out existing members (14 in composer, 12 available to add — 2 already in group) and adding emp-sophie closes the modal and persists; msg-emoji-btn opens msg-emoji-panel with exactly 20 emoji buttons and clicking 😀 inserts it into msg-input; msg-file-input accepts a PNG, msg-pending-attachments preview shows, msg-send posts message and msg-attachment-image renders the uploaded image inline. No console errors during flow beyond two harmless 404s (favicon).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 7003 lines — still needs to be split into modules (channels, messages, uploads, ideas, birthdays, notifications). Every iteration keeps growing this file.

Messagerie.jsx is 1155 lines and mixes composer modal, info panel, attachments, emoji picker and add-member modal — should be broken into sub-components (ChatComposer, ChatInfoPanel, AddMemberModal, MessageAttachment already extracted).
POST /api/uploads has no auth check nor MIME allow-list — any authenticated employee can upload up to 8 MB of any file type; consider content-type allow-list for /api/uploads used from chat.

PATCH /api/channels/{cid} and member add/remove endpoints do not check that current_user() is a member (or creator) of the group — any authenticated employee can rename, change avatar or add/remove members of any group. Consider authorization guard.
Message post accepts arbitrary attachments payload (list of dict) with no schema validation — should be a Pydantic model with url/name/type fields to prevent oversize/malformed data being stored.
